Method of Attack: JavaScript e-skimmer script stealing payment card information at checkout
Steals cardholder name, card number, expiration date, CVV, email, username, password, address details, and phone number
Uses fake Google Tag Manager snippet to hide malicious code
Loads malicious script 'apiV3.js' from a typosquatted domain 'mogento.info'
Sends encrypted payload via POST to 'mogento.info/images/visa-mastercard-amex_0.png'
Attack Vector: Injected JavaScript code on checkout pages (/onepage, /firecheckout) of Sixth June website
